episodes.title: Les cramés
episodes.summary: Lyès and his team bust a drug deal with shady new players — and face heat from Commissioner Fabiani. Interpol agent Alice Vidal arrives in Marseille.

episodes.title: Intégration
episodes.summary: Assigned to "clean up" the precinct, Miranda questions Lyès, Alice and the team. Ali Saïdi returns for his nephew's burial, determined to get answers.

episodes.title: En approche
episodes.summary: Bakari goes missing. After visiting Peretto in prison, Lyès and Alice go to Spain. Commissioner Fabiani fends off Internal Affairs over a tense lunch.

episodes.title: Confrontation
episodes.summary: Alice's true motives are revealed. Lyès chases new leads and has a rendezvous with Ali; Murillo escalates matters by kidnapping a member of the team.

episodes.title: Les liens du sang
episodes.summary: Murillo makes his move. Determined to get dirt on Lyès, Miranda presses Arno and Tatoo. A past romance is brought to light while Alice is undercover.

episodes.title: La traque
episodes.summary: Lyès makes a risky play to bait Murillo, but Ali retaliates. As Internal Affairs closes in on his team, a shocking discovery turns the case on its head.

episodes.title: Derrière les murs
episodes.summary: Having landed in prison, Lyès has a target on his back. On the outside, the squad faces a violent new gang making its presence known in Marseille.

episodes.title: Los Xetas
episodes.summary: In response to the violent events, Miranda heads up a task force to take down the gang. As Lyès awaits his prison transfer, he prepares a bold move.

episodes.title: De l'autre côté
episodes.summary: As the walls close in on Audrey, Arno asks Beckerman for a favor. Lyès makes contact with his sister, and the Djaoui brothers test their new recruit.

episodes.title: Ennemis intimes
episodes.summary: Lyès finally gets to see the squad again. Ali receives a solid business proposition. Word gets out about the bust at Verlet's rental agency.

episodes.title: La vérité
episodes.summary: An explosive gold delivery brings multiple sides face to face as Ali's drug shipment hangs on his men's success. Miranda turns the screw on Lyès.

episodes.title: La confiance
episodes.summary: The team reels from the news of the latest death. Lyès receives on an urgent mission and Tatoo asks Assia for help before telling her to leave town.
